observation: Fresh-main inspection found the published changeset v0.3 id pattern is lowercase-only (^cs-[a-f0-9]+$), while ChangesetStore.file() used the same expression with the case-insensitive flag. A manually persisted uppercase id could therefore pass the storage identity boundary even though it violates the checked-in contract.
changes: Remove case-insensitive matching from the ChangesetStore storage-id gate so durable ids match the published lowercase-only v0.3 pattern.
Add a focused regression preserving canonical lowercase ids while rejecting uppercase hex or prefix variants.
